description: This PHP source file provides a web interface for editing wireless network configurations (SSID, security modes, channels, passwords) on a network gateway. It includes HTML markup, inline JavaScript for form handling and validation, and server-side PHP code for processing and pre-filling configuration data.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Fetches specific Wi-Fi configuration parameters from external data source using DmExtGetStrsWithRootObj

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog for configuring Wi-Fi security modes with options for Open, WEP, and WPA2-PSK

methods.name: addslashes
methods.description: Escapes backslashes, quotes, and null characters in a string for safe inclusion in JSON or JavaScript strings

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Gathers form data and submits the updated wireless configuration via AJAX to the server PHP handler

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Initiates a reset/restoration of Wi-Fi settings by sending reset information via AJAX and reloading the page

methods.name: init_form
methods.description: Initializes form fields based on current configuration parameters, enables/disables controls, and sets default selections
